about: Every release, newest first, and what it changed on each side: the scanner and the server (PLAN.md D197, D217; the server was the home before 1.2.0, D225 -- the key stays "home", which every scanner since 1.1.1 reads). versions.py reads it, and the help site builds its page of every version from it.

scanner.zh: 扫描时打开一位共鸣者的「属性详情」「技能」「武器」，或在声骸背包里点声骸，扫描器会读出等级、技能等级、游戏面板、武器和声骸，记到这位共鸣者名下，「计算」从这里开始。连着服务器的扫描器会把它们随扫描一起发过去：只有文字和数字，从不发画面
scanner.en: during a scan, opening a resonator's 属性详情, 技能 or 武器 screen, or clicking echoes in their echo bag, reads their level, skill levels, the game's panel, weapon and echoes into that resonator, and 计算 starts from them. A scanner with a server sends them with its scans: words and numbers only, never a picture

home.zh: 新页面「计算」：选一位共鸣者，按等级、技能、武器、声骸和敌人算出每个技能的伤害、治疗和护盾；每个增益都能开关、改数值，面板也能直接填
home.en: a new page, 计算: pick a resonator and it works out every skill's damage, heals and shields from their level, skills, weapon, echoes and the enemy; every buff can be switched and its number changed, and the panel can be typed in

home.zh: 「计算」和这位共鸣者自己的最好配置比，告诉你是小毕业还是大毕业、差在哪；治疗角色按治疗量算（维里奈看攻击，守岸人看生命），技能里写了上限的（如守岸人的共鸣效率 250%）单独一条；每个声骸的副词条按档位打分
home.en: 计算 grades the build against the same resonator at their best -- 小毕业 or 大毕业, and what is short; a healer is judged by their heals (维里奈 on ATK, 守岸人 on HP), and a cap their own skill names (守岸人's 250% 共鸣效率) is a line of its own; each echo's substats are rated by tier

home.zh: A、B 对比：换几个声骸、换一把武器、或多一个共鸣链，每个技能的每一行都显示变化
home.en: A against B: change a few echoes, the weapon, or the 共鸣链, and every row of every skill shows the change

home.zh: 敌人可以选全息战略（难度六，按今州、黎那汐塔分组，显示它的词条）、野外首领，或自己填
home.en: the enemy can be a 全息 at 难度六, grouped as the game groups them (今州, 黎那汐塔) with its words shown, an overworld boss, or one of your own

home.zh: 「更新」多了两步：下载「计算」要用的游戏数据，和每个声骸、套装的图片
home.en: 更新 has two more steps: 计算's game data, and the pictures of every echo and set

home.zh: 扫描器读到的共鸣者面板会到服务器上，服务器的「计算」直接用；两台电脑读同一位共鸣者时，留最新的那次
home.en: the resonator screens a scanner reads arrive on the server, and its 计算 starts from them; when two PCs read the same resonator, the newest reading stays

home.zh: 「计算」更全了：每把武器按持有的谐振等级排名，声骸按副词条的贡献比较，异常效应（如光噪效应）的伤害、持续治疗和额外伤害各成一行，增益按在场时间计；每把武器的被动、每个套装和每位共鸣者的增益都逐条核对过
home.en: 计算 does more: every weapon ranked at the rank it would be held, echoes compared by what their substats add, a status effect's own damage (光噪效应 and others), heals over time and extra hits as rows of their own, and buffs counted by time on the field; every weapon's passive, every set and every resonator's own buffs were checked by hand

home.zh: 「配队」：最多三人一队，看每个人给队友什么，排好的轮转加起来算
home.en: 配队: a team of up to three, what each gives the others, and a rotation added up

home.zh: 新页面「套装」：每个声骸套装都能查，写明它需要哪种异常效应
home.en: a new page, 套装: every echo set, to look one up, with the status effect it needs

home.zh: 新页面「设置」：拖动导航里的页面排成自己的顺序、隐藏不用的；语言、漂泊者和数据（原在「更新」）都在这里
home.en: a new page, 设置: drag the pages into your own order and hide the ones you do not use; the language, your 漂泊者 and the data (from 更新) are here

home.zh: 「更新」多一步「官方攻略」：鸣潮角色攻略资料站推荐的声骸套装，也成为「计算」的推荐；更新后会说新增或重画了哪些图片
home.en: 更新 has one more step, 官方攻略: the echo sets Kuro's official guide site recommends, which join 计算's recommended; after an update it says which pictures were added or drawn again

home.zh: 「更新」里某个请求失败时不再卡在那里：其他的先继续，失败的稍后再试；「官方攻略」像浏览器一样连接，只下载有变化的攻略
home.en: 更新 no longer waits on a request that failed: the others go on and it is asked again later; 官方攻略 connects as a browser does and fetches only the guides that changed

home.zh: 「计算」和「配队」有英文：技能、每一行和共鸣者的名字
home.en: 计算 and 配队 in English: the skills, their rows and the resonator's name

home.zh: 「料理」第一次打开时会问哪些食谱学会了（联动的默认算没学会）；没学会的料理不再算缺。之后从「学会了哪些食谱？」随时改
home.en: 料理 asks, the first time it opens, which recipes are learned (the 联动 ones start as not learned); a dish whose recipe is not learned is no longer counted short. 学会了哪些食谱？ changes it any time

home.zh: 「版权与致谢」加上致谢：leongiscoding（Mac 版的测试和改进）和 BaconCoding74（扫描器的基础）
home.en: 版权与致谢 now thanks leongiscoding (testing and improving the Mac side) and BaconCoding74 (the scanner's base)

home.zh: 「总览」的规划改成一个规划一张卡：头像、名字、从几级到几级、几种材料已经够了，下面是还不够的材料和要去打的首领，不用再把鼠标停在头像上
home.en: on 总览, each plan is a card of its own: the face, the name, the levels it goes between, how many of its materials are there, then what is still short and the boss each drops from -- nothing waits behind a hover

home.zh: 卡上每个材料角上是这个规划要的数量，红色标签是所有规划合计还缺多少；点头像打开角色或武器，点材料打开材料
home.en: each material on a card shows this plan's amount in the corner and, on the red tag, what all the plans together still lack; the face opens the resonator or weapon, a material its own panel

home.zh: 「总览」的「规划还缺的材料」里，点头像会打开那个角色或武器的详情
home.en: on 总览, a click on a face under 规划还缺的材料 opens that resonator's or weapon's panel

home.zh: 鼠标停在头像上会显示这个规划还缺哪些材料、各要多少；都够了就显示「材料都够了」
home.en: resting on a face shows the materials its plan is still short of, with this plan's amount of each, or 材料都够了 when nothing is

home.zh: 修复：「这是谁」选错了没地方改。现在「武器」页的扫描信息里有「认错了？改名字」，武器详情里的持有者也能点开改
home.en: fixed: a wrong pick in 这是谁 could not be changed. The 武器 page's scan line now has 认错了？改名字, and the holder in a weapon's panel opens the same picker

home.zh: 修复：手动填的新角色在「规划」里算不出材料，会显示不需要材料。现在会把你填的全部材料算进合计
home.en: fixed: a new character filled in by hand counted for nothing in 规划, which said no materials were needed. Everything you entered now counts in the total

home.zh: 「规划」的选人列表最上面多了「即将实装」：填好的可以直接加，还没填的可以一键去「手动修改」
home.en: 规划's picker has a 即将实装 group on top: ready to add once filled in, with a link to 手动修改 if not

home.zh: 手动提前填的角色、武器和材料，等 Wiki 有了完整数据，点「更新」就会自动换成 Wiki 的，并提示一次；你改过的已上线内容不受影响
home.en: characters, weapons and materials you added ahead of a patch switch to the wiki's data on 更新 once it has them all, and it says so once. Your fixes to anything already released stay

home.zh: 「帮助」的第一步和第三步改成双击文件，不用再打命令；背包是空的时候也这样提示
home.en: 帮助's first steps are double-clicks now, with no commands to type, and an empty 库存 says the same

scanner.zh: 修复：换到新服务器时，扫描记录很多的扫描器会报「上传的内容太大」，之后每次都失败。现在分批发送，中断后也能接着传
scanner.en: fixed: a scanner with a lot of data moved to a new server stopped with "上传的内容太大", and every push after failed too. It now sends in parts, and picks up where it stopped

scanner.zh: 修复：「可能认错」会把名字没错的物品也标出来（如 异响空灵、漪澜浮录、超级豹风雪）。现在会把游戏里的图和图鉴的图放在一起比，图也不一样才标
scanner.en: fixed: 可能认错 flagged items whose names were right, such as 异响空灵, 漪澜浮录 and 超级豹风雪. It now compares the game's picture with the catalogue's, and flags a name only when the pictures differ too

scanner.zh: 修复：详情面板里选中物品的大图，偶尔会被当成一个多出来的物品，分页就显示成 175/174 这样，一直算不上扫全
scanner.en: fixed: the big picture in the detail panel could be read as one more item, so a tab said 175 of 174 and never counted as complete

scanner.zh: 修复：画面上下两排都被滚动区域切掉一截时，被切的格子可能被当成物品，多出 1 星、数量不对的假物品。现在只读完整的格子
scanner.en: fixed: when the scroll view cut a row at both the top and the bottom of the screen, the cut tiles could be read as items, giving false 1-star items with wrong counts. Only whole tiles are read now

scanner.zh: 扫描页顶部现在会显示手机能打开的网址和端口；没有分享时，会告诉你怎么打开
scanner.en: the top of the scan page now shows the address and port your phone can open, or how to turn that on

scanner.zh: 有 Tailscale 时，双击 扫描 Scan 或用它的快捷方式，手机就能看扫描进度，不用再输命令。只有你自己的 Tailscale 设备能打开；没有 Tailscale 时，扫描和以前一样
scanner.en: with Tailscale, 扫描 Scan and its shortcuts now share the scan's status with your phone, with no command to type. Only your own Tailscale devices can open it. Without Tailscale a scan runs as before

scanner.zh: 扫描页和手机页都有「Stop the scan」按钮，按两下结束扫描，和 F9 一样，读到的都会保存。Mac 和手机上不用再找快捷键
scanner.en: the scan page and the phone's page now have a Stop the scan button: two presses end the scan just as F9 does, and everything read is kept. A Mac or a phone no longer needs a key for it

scanner.zh: 安装指南的第一步现在有图：解压之前先解除锁定。新版 Windows 11 的智能应用控制拦下文件时该怎么办，也写清楚了
scanner.en: the install guide's first step now shows, in pictures, how to unblock the zip before unzipping it, and says what to do when Smart App Control on a new Windows 11 blocks a file with no Run button

scanner.zh: 只留下「服务器」这个名字：旧的 wuwa-home 和 wuwa home 命令已移除，旧文件会自动改名，已连接的服务器不用重新设置
scanner.en: only the name server is left: the old wuwa-home and the wuwa home command are gone. Old files take their new names by themselves, so a scanner keeps its server

home.zh: 帮助页的「出了问题怎么办」多了一张带图的卡片：新版 Windows 11 的智能应用控制拦下 .cmd 时该怎么解除锁定
home.en: Help's When something goes wrong has a new card, with drawings: how to unblock a .cmd that Smart App Control on a new Windows 11 blocked

home.zh: 服务器现在只有一个容器（程序和 Tailscale 在一起），重启和更新不会再报 “network namespace” 错误。旧配置文件还能继续用；要改成一个容器，粘贴一次新的配置文件，步骤见帮助
home.en: the server is now one container (the app and Tailscale together), so a restart or an update can no longer fail with a "network namespace" error. The older compose file keeps working; to move, paste the new one once: the help says how

home.zh: 修复：上传或更新图鉴时，页面会报错打不开（database is locked）。现在读取不再需要等待，保存也会排队完成
home.en: fixed: pages failed with "database is locked" during an upload or a wiki update. Reading no longer waits, and a save takes its turn

home.zh: 修复：从零开始的服务器上，识别页的「可能认错」永远是空的。现在服务器自带图鉴的参考数据，可以核对学到的名字
home.en: fixed: on a server started from nothing, 识别's 可能认错 stayed empty however wrong a name was. A server now has the catalogue's reference data to check learned names against

home.zh: 修复：「可能认错」会把名字没错的物品也标出来（如 异响空灵、漪澜浮录、超级豹风雪）。现在会把游戏里的图和图鉴的图放在一起比，图也不一样才标
home.en: fixed: 可能认错 flagged items whose names were right, such as 异响空灵, 漪澜浮录 and 超级豹风雪. It now compares the game's picture with the catalogue's, and flags a name only when the pictures differ too

scanner.zh: 连接服务器时马上下载图鉴，第一次扫描不用再等
scanner.en: connecting to a server fetches the catalogue at once, so the first scan does not wait

scanner.zh: 换到一台全新的服务器时，扫描器会把所有记录都带过去，什么也不会丢
scanner.en: moving to a brand-new server brings everything this scanner has, and loses nothing

home.zh: 商店：手机上底数单独占一行，从左边开始，填 400 也不会超出格子
home.en: shops: on a phone the base has its own line, from the left, so 400 no longer runs out of the tile

home.zh: 商店：「差」放到「限」下面一行，数字再长也不会叠在一起
home.en: shops: what is short sits on the line under the limit, so a long number never runs over it

home.zh: 选中多样后的批量操作（商店、共鸣者、料理）会显示进度，每 10 样一批
home.en: actions on picked items (shops, resonators, cooking) show how far they have got, ten at a time

home.zh: 服务器有了自己的身份，换了新服务器的扫描器能认出来
home.en: a server now says who it is, so a scanner can tell when it has been moved to a new one

scanner.zh: 安装时分别问要不要在桌面、开始菜单放快捷方式；「连接服务器」的快捷方式只在你说要时才放
scanner.en: setup asks about the Desktop and the Start menu one at a time; a Connect server shortcut only if you say yes

scanner.zh: Mac 也能放快捷方式：桌面和「应用程序」（启动台、聚焦搜索都找得到）
scanner.en: shortcuts on a Mac too: on the Desktop and in Applications, where Launchpad and Spotlight find them

scanner.zh: 新的「5 卸载 Uninstall」：去掉快捷方式和程序，先问扫描记录和设置要不要一起删（默认留下）
scanner.en: a new 5 卸载 Uninstall: removes the shortcuts and the program, and asks first whether your scans and settings go too (they stay unless you say yes)

home.zh: 网页里的物品图标改用 WebP：库存页的图标从 15.6 MB 变成 4.0 MB，打开更快；发给扫描端的图鉴仍是 PNG
home.en: the pages' item icons are WebP: the inventory's icons go from 15.6 MB to 4.0 MB and open faster; the catalogue sent to scanners stays PNG

scanner.zh: 修复：扫描开始前出现 database is locked，wuwa live 无法扫描
scanner.en: fixed: wuwa live stopped before scanning with "database is locked"

scanner.zh: 修复：保存的 wuwa-home 改名成 wuwa-server 后扫描器无法开始；现在会自动跟上新名字，找不到服务器时就先在本机扫描，下次再发送
scanner.en: fixed: a saved wuwa-home renamed to wuwa-server stopped the scanner; it now follows the new name, and with no server found it scans on its own and sends the scans next time

scanner.zh: 主机改叫服务器：「2 连接服务器 Connect server」、wuwa server set、server.key；旧的 wuwa home 和 home.key 照样能用
scanner.en: the home is now the server: 2 连接服务器 Connect server, wuwa server set, server.key; the old wuwa home and home.key still work

scanner.zh: 连接服务器时地址直接按回车：先找 wuwa-server，再找以前的 wuwa-home
scanner.en: Enter at the server's address tries wuwa-server, then the older wuwa-home

scanner.zh: 安装最后可以在桌面和开始菜单放快捷方式（Windows）：WuWa Scan、WuWa Dashboard
scanner.en: setup can put shortcuts on the Desktop and in the Start menu (Windows): WuWa Scan, WuWa Dashboard

scanner.zh: Mac 程序包带图文指南 START-HERE.html
scanner.en: the Mac packages carry a picture guide, START-HERE.html

home.zh: 主机改叫服务器：镜像叫 wuwa-inventory-vision-server（旧名字照样更新）；钥匙复制成 server.key，home.key 留着
home.en: the home is now the server: the image is wuwa-inventory-vision-server (the old name keeps updating); the key is copied to server.key, home.key kept

home.zh: 「更新 › 数据 › 版本」只列最新的和正在用的版本，全部版本在帮助网站
home.en: Update › Data › Versions lists the newest and the versions in use; every version is on the help site

scanner.zh: 连接服务器时钥匙那一步直接按回车：从「下载」文件夹里拿最新的 server.key（NAS 打不开 .key 文件也没关系）
scanner.en: Connect server takes the key from Downloads when you press Enter: the newest server.key there (for a NAS that cannot open .key files)

home.zh: 服务器的网络由一个更新永远不会换掉的小容器拿着，NAS 的「更新」不再报 No such container（要先粘贴新的配置文件一次）
home.en: the server's network is held by a tiny container no update replaces, so the NAS app's update no longer fails with No such container (paste the new compose file once)

home.zh: 图标统一成一套：所在的页显示实心图标，鼠标停上去各有动画；总览换成指南针
home.en: one family of icons: the page you are on shows its icon solid, each moves on hover; Overview is a compass

home.zh: 手机上商店的价格和底数是格子自己的底栏；版本列表分开写扫描端和服务器改了什么
home.en: on a phone a shop tile's price and base are its own foot; the version list shows what each side changed, and what to update

home.zh: 折叠屏和 300 像素宽的手机上，帮助、商店、我的共鸣者、版本列表和「这是谁」都排得整齐
home.en: on a folded phone and screens 300 px wide, Help, Shops, My resonators, the version list and "Who is this?" read right

home.zh: 下拉列表不会被会滚动的列表挡住；逐个命名悬停时不再变暗；数据页两个方块之间有间距
home.en: a dropdown is never cut off by a list that scrolls; Name them one by one no longer dims under the pointer; the Data page's two boxes have a gap

scanner.zh: 连接服务器时比较两边的版本，说哪边该更新、缺什么
scanner.en: compares versions with the server, and says which side to update and why

scanner.zh: 服务器比较新时，双击「4 更新 Update」自己更新
scanner.en: updates itself with 4 更新 Update when the server is newer

scanner.zh: Mac 版程序包（mac-full、mac-scanner）
scanner.en: packages for a Mac (mac-full, mac-scanner)

scanner.zh: 认得超级豹风雪；奇幻变奏不再没有名字；一模一样的物品不再拿来学习
scanner.en: 超级豹风雪 is named; 奇幻变奏 is no longer left unnamed; items drawn exactly alike are not learned

home.zh: 总览说最新的扫描是哪个版本的扫描端做的；更新页列出每个版本改了哪边
home.en: Overview says which scanner version made the newest scans; Update lists what each version changed on which side

home.zh: 待确认的物品说它可能是哪几样，而不是说它们长得一模一样
home.en: an item waiting to be confirmed says what it could be, not that the candidates look identical

home.zh: 第一次下载图鉴快了几倍；钱包每种货币取各自最新的读数
home.en: the first catalogue download is several times faster; each wallet amount is its own newest reading

home.zh: 快速连点共鸣者进度会合起来保存；共鸣者和武器默认显示已拥有
home.en: quick clicks on a resonator's progress are saved together; Resonators and Weapons open on Owned

home.zh: 识别不列一模一样的物品，说明也改清楚了
home.en: Recognition leaves out items drawn exactly alike, and says better what it is

scanner.zh: 特殊料理不再认成原料理（青蔬蛋饼）
scanner.en: special dishes are told from their base dish (青蔬蛋饼)

scanner.zh: 颜色挡掉了正确的图时改为待确认（千古洑流、气动阻抗喷雾）
scanner.en: a tile whose right picture was shut out on colour waits for a click (千古洑流, 气动阻抗喷雾)

scanner.zh: 数量相同的两个标签页不再合并；新物品第一次扫描就认识
scanner.en: two tabs with the same count are kept apart; new items are known on the first scan

scanner.zh: 扫描页显示还没扫描的标签；连接服务器只要 wuwa-home
